name: MATH
intro: MATH数据集包含12500道具有完整步骤解答的竞赛数学题，旨在衡量机器学习模型的数学问题解决能力。完整解答可用于训练模型生成答案推导和解释，促进数学推理相关研究和准确率提升。
build_method: 竞赛真题采掘 (AMC/AIME/AoPS), 7门学科分类, AoPS 1–5级难度分级, LaTeX/Asymptote规范化排版, 完整推导与boxed答案标注
metric: 符号精确匹配准确率 (Exact Match Accuracy)
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 少样本CoT思维链, LaTeX boxed答案正则抽取, SymPy符号数学等价性校验, 7学科与5难度分层统计
build_method_en: Competition curation (AMC 10/12, AIME, AoPS), 7 subject taxonomy, AoPS Level 1–5 difficulty grading, LaTeX and Asymptote typesetting, step-by-step boxed derivations
eval_feature_en: Few-shot CoT prompting, LaTeX boxed regex extraction, SymPy symbolic equivalence checking, 7-subject and 5-level matrix breakdown
intro_en: The MATH dataset contains 12,500 competition-level math problems with full step-by-step solutions, designed to evaluate the mathematical problem-solving ability of machine learning models. The complete solutions can be used to train models to generate answer derivations and explanations, promoting research in mathematical reasoning and improving accuracy.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2103.03874 Sections 3.1 and 4.1. MATH collects 12,500 high-school competition problems from AMC 10, AMC 12, AIME, and AoPS across 7 subjects and AoPS difficulty levels 1 to 5. Problems and solutions are formatted in LaTeX with geometry figures in Asymptote. The release splits into 7,500 training and 5,000 test problems. Evaluation runs via few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting, regex/AST parsing of \boxed{} final answers, SymPy symbolic mathematical equivalence checking, and exact match accuracy reporting.
